title: MedNorm-VI AI second-opinion adjudication, v1
description: One independent adjudication returned by a SECOND AI system over the blind packet (Audit 0067). This is deliberately a separate schema and a separate status from the first model's draft: if both wrote into one representation, agreement between them would be unmeasurable and 'consensus' unfalsifiable. A record conforming to this schema is NEVER human gold. The schema is tracked; the returned decisions are private and gitignored because they reference clinical records.

annotation_id.description: Must match a record in the blind packet exactly.

selected_codes.description: Only codes present in that record's offered_candidates. ICD entries MUST be dotless internal identities; the dotted form is display only.

evidence_used.description: Which evidence fields drove the decision, e.g. context_after, specificity_class, tty, strength.

competing_codes.description: Candidates that stayed plausible. For ABSTAIN this is where the unresolved alternatives belong.

ambiguity_flags.description: Free-vocabulary reason codes, e.g. drug_class, brand_not_in_kb, lexical_false_friend, parent_child_ambiguity, tty_ambiguity, strength_mismatch.

allOf.description: NO_VALID_CANDIDATE asserts that none is correct, so it may not also name one.
ABSTAIN means unresolved; alternatives belong in competing_codes, not selected_codes.
SELECTED must name at least one code.
